The '''Helix J-104 starfighter''',<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> also known as the '''Bounty Hunter Fighter''', was a class of [[starfighter]]<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Star Wars: The Mandalorian - Illustrated Outlaws|cardname=Bounty Hunter Fighter}}</ref> that was used the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref> as well as after its [[Battle of Jakku|fall]]. It had a flat appearance with a central [[cockpit]], which could fit one [[pilot]] and two wings, where an [[engine]] was located between them.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="OutlawsDate">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> the [[starship]] was sold for for 45,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] as part of a flash sale that was advertised in parts of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]], [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] and [[Wild Space]].<ref name="Outlaws" /> The [[bounty hunter]] [[Riot Mar]] used [[Riot Mar's starfighter|one of]] the starfighters while pursuing the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]]<ref name="Chapter 5" /> in [[9 ABY]].<ref name="MandoDate">{{MandoDate|5}}</ref> Djarin, flying his [[gunship]] ''[[Razor Crest]]'', maneuvered behind the bounty hunter and destroyed his fighter.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Helix J-104 starfighter was first teased in the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aOC8E8z_ifw official trailer]<ref name="Trailer 1">{{SWYouTube|aOC8E8z_ifw|The Mandalorian | Official Trailer | Disney+ | Streaming Nov. 12|sw_url=video/the-mandalorian-official-trailer}}</ref> for [[Jon Favreau]]'s live-action television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''.<ref name="Production begins">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-revealed|text=''The Mandalorian'' First Image, Directors Revealed}}</ref> The fighter first appeared in the [[Chapter 5: The Gunslinger|fifth]] episode of the show, which was directed by Dave Filoni<ref name="Chapter 5" /> and aired on [[December 6]], [[2019]].<ref name="DTCI">{{WebCite|url=https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/the_mandalorian_project_one-sheet_10_ec1e005f.pdf|text=The Mandalorian Media Kit|work=[https://dtcimedia.disney.com Disney Direct-to-Consumer & International]|archivedate=20230315011507}}</ref> It was first named in the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''.<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> [[Doug Chiang]]'s team looked to the American [[Wikipedia:F-100 Super Sabre|F-100 Super Sabre]] jet fighter for inspiration.<ref name="Art of Mando">[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season One)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One]]</ref>
